parameters.name: FromExecTime
parameters.description: The minimum task execution time in seconds. Filters for tasks that took longer than this value. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: FromStartTime
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query, based on task start time. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and must be in `UTC+0` time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

The earliest supported time is 30 days ago. If the specified time is more than 30 days ago, it will be automatically converted to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID to filter by. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 IDs. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction.

> Currently, only PolarDB cluster IDs are supported.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: positive integers. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- **Scheduled**: waiting for execution

- **Running**: executing

- **Succeed**: executed successfully

- **Cancelling**: stopping

- **Canceled**: stopped

- **Waiting**: waiting for preset time

You can provide a comma-separated list. Default value: empty, which indicates all statuses.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 IDs. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The task type. You can provide a comma-separated list of up to 30 task types. Default value: empty, indicating no restriction.

parameters.name: ToExecTime
parameters.description: The maximum task execution time in seconds. Filters for tasks that took less than this value. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: ToStartTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query, based on task start time. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and must be in `UTC+0` time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.
